title: EasyClay
description: Makes clay blocks easier to spot by adding a visible red marker overlay. Designed for faster clay farming and efficient mason villager trading in survival worlds.
body:
# EasyClay

EasyClay is a lightweight utility resource pack that highlights clay blocks with a bright red border, making them much easier to spot in rivers, lakes, oceans, and caves.

Designed for players who farm clay for mason villager trading or large building projects.

## Features

* Bright red clay outline
* Vanilla-friendly style
* Lightweight and simple
* Great for survival gameplay
* Helps with emerald farming

## Recommended Use

Best used while exploring riverbeds and underwater areas where clay can be difficult to notice.
